messages:
incident-bot: ALERT - High failure rate detected on /v1/chat (action-call path). 5xx rate spiked to 8% (baseline 0.4%). Agent/tool invocations up 6x in last 5m. Incident INC-2026-0423 created.
ashley_oncall: I'm paged and looking. Matt / Sara / Ryan please ack and standby.
matt: ack, oncall - pulling dashboard now. Which tenants are noisy?
sara: I see a correlation with recent tool-connector rollout (connector-v2) and increased response payload size. queue length on agent-executor up ~3x, downstream tool gateway returning 502/504.
ashley_oncall: Initial mitigation plan (aiming to reduce load quickly):
  1) Introduce emergency per-key rate limits on action-invoke route (soft cap for 10m)
  2) Disable structured payload mode globally so model responses are plaintext only (reduce payload size and parsing work)
  3) Temporarily pause the new tool-connector rollout (rollback canary)
  4) Quarantine top noisy tenants if they exceed new caps
  5) Notify CS for impacted customers and mark status page
Can someone own each? I'll flip flags and coordinate with infra for rate limit push.
ryan: I can take tenant quarantine and CS notification.
lia: I'll draft customer-facing blurb for status page and ping support to prepare templates.
sara: How do you flip the structured payload flag? We have per-tenant and global toggles. Recommend global false for 15m while we stabilize.
ashley_oncall: Executing global flip now. Command:
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/feature-flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"flag":"structured_response_enabled","scope":"global","value":false,"ttl_seconds":900}'
```
ops-bot: Feature flag update request received: id=ff-4821, user=ashley_oncall.
deploy-bot: Feature flag ff-4821 applied: structured_response_enabled=false (scope=global, ttl=900s).
matt: Pushing emergency rate-limit rule to edge: set route /v1/chat/action-invoke default=12rps, free-tier=6rps, burst=30. Applying via rlctl: 
```
rlctl push --route "/v1/chat/action-invoke" --policy '{"default":12,"free_tier":6,"burst":30,"window_seconds":1}'
```
ops-bot: Rate limit policy applied to /v1/chat/action-invoke (policy id rl-775).
ryan: Quarantining tenant acme-inc and beta-x because of repeated retries & large payloads. Setting per-tenant cap to 4rps and disabling structured responses at tenant level (redundant but explicit).
lia: Status page update: "We are experiencing degraded performance for some chat features. Responses may be returned in plain text while we mitigate. We will provide updates every 30 minutes." Posting now.
ashley_oncall: Rolling back connector-v2 canary in staging and prod canary groups. Command: 
```
ctl deploy rollback --service tool-connector --from=connector-v2 --to=connector-v1.3 --canary-groups=all
```
matt: Rollback started; monitor logs. Early signals: tool-gateway 502s dropping in canary pods.
sara: Also trimmed streaming chunk size for agent runtime to avoid long-lived connections. Applied streaming.max_chunk_size=64KB temporarily.
ashley_oncall: Good. Quick customer impact triage: Hit list from telemetry: acme-inc (high), knightlytics (medium), several free-tier bots noisy. Lia please make account-specific notes and CS owners.
lia: Done. Lia->CS owners: acme-inc (carrie), knightlytics (mike). Templates queued.
ryan: I'm going to watch metrics for 45m. If error rate drops below 1% for 20m, we'll relax controls gradually. I'll also prepare a gradual re-enable path for structured responses per-tenant.
matt: Confirming resource pressure is down: agent-executor queue length halved, token throughput down ~40%. 5xx now 1.8% and trending down.
ashley_oncall: Nice work. Next steps: keep feature flag off globally for 15m, then re-enable per-tenant as we validate. Maintain rate limits and per-tenant caps for at least 30m total. Ryan you'll own watch and escalate back to me if >3% persists.
ryan: Acknowledged, taking over watch. Putting note on-call handoff: I'll be primary for the next 60 minutes then hand off to matt.
matt: I'll standby for handoff. Also recommend follow-up action: (A) add guard to connector rollout to auto-stop at 2% error rate, (B) add heavier e2e load test for structured payload path.
sara: Logging/alerts action: create an alert to trigger when action-invoke latency >500ms and 5xx >2% for >5m. I'll add runbook link.
ashley_oncall: Assigning post-incident: root-cause spike related to connector-v2 payload handling and missing per-route throttles. We'll do a mini postmortem after stabilization. Thanks all.
incident-bot: INC-2026-0423 status changed: mitigations applied (rate-limits, structured-response OFF, connector rollback). Monitoring for 30m. Updates will be appended to this thread.
ryan: Quick note for CS: affected customers may see shorter/simple outputs and temporarily disabled tool-based actions (e.g., retrieval actions, DB writes). Recommend offering replays to customers after resolution.
lia: Customer messages sent to owners for acme-inc & knightlytics. I'll prepare broader status update if we need >2hr mitigation.
matt: Observability note: save metric window from 20:00-20:30 UTC for post-incident analysis (spike).
ashley_oncall: Handing off fully to ryan now. If anything pops, ping @ryan and escalate.
ryan: taking over. I will post an update at +15m and +45m.
incident-bot: Update INC-2026-0423: 15m check - 5xx at 0.9%, rate stable. Continue monitoring.
